submission.justification: S3 has the highest nominal significance (4.1σ) but fails the hard validation constraint (35% data/MC disagreement vs 10% limit). Of the remaining options, S1 (NN on kinematic variables, 6% disagreement) beats S2 (cut-based, 3%) in significance: 3.4σ vs 2.6σ. I recommend S1 at the 50% efficiency working point. That is the only point for which I have a significance figure, and it is statistics-only. I did not run a working-point scan, because no simulation tool was available to me. The 3.4σ is therefore not an optimized value.

requirements.evidence: Among the allowed strategies, S1 gives 3.4σ vs S2 2.6σ (2025 summary, 50% efficiency, statistical uncertainty only). The working point was not optimized.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed strategies

requirements.evidence: S1 has 6%. S3 has 35% and was rejected.
